name: Ahmed Al-Sayed
summary: Runs a catering company in Doha that has grown quickly over the past two years. He has come in to talk about banking options for his business.
openingLine: Hello, thanks for making time to see me. My catering business has been growing quickly, and I think it's time to look at what the bank can do for us.
personality: Friendly but busy, and wants to get to the point. Speaks in practical business terms and gets impatient with jargon or long sales pitches. Warms up to bankers who show genuine interest in his business. Answers questions directly, but does not bring up problems he has not been asked about.
background: Founded Saffron Table Catering 8 years ago with his savings and help from family. Has 25 employees, mostly chefs and event staff, paid through the Wage Protection System. Annual revenue is about QAR 6 million, up roughly 40% in two years. About 70% of revenue comes from corporate clients: hotels, event companies and two government-linked organisations. The business is profitable and has audited financial statements for the last 3 years. Married with three children.
